notes.title: About Current Status & Next Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I’m thrilled to share details about the upcoming update, which introduces major gameplay improvements and new features. Before diving into the specifics, I want to address the Gang Update schedule and apologize for the recent delay in updates.

[b]Why the Delay?[/b]
I know it’s been a while since the last update, and I want to apologize for that. The reason for the delay is simple: I’ve been working tirelessly to make sure this upcoming update is polished and packed with exciting features. I’m confident you’ll find it worth the wait!

[b]Gang Update Schedule[/b]
Previously, I mentioned a planned release date for the Gang Update, but I’ve decided to postpone it. This decision ensures that it will align seamlessly with the newly introduced Skill Tree System, enhancing your gameplay experience. The Gang Update will bring exciting features like gang missions, illegal activities, progression systems, and items from the gang store—all of which will integrate perfectly with the skill tree mechanics.

Thank you for your patience and understanding as I focus on making this the best possible experience for you!



[b]What’s Coming in the Next Update?[/b]

[b]Redesigned Header Bar[/b]
[list]
[*] The top UI bar has been revamped for a cleaner and more visually appealing look, complete with new icons and visuals.
[/list]
[b]Shortcut Bar Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The bottom shortcut bar can now be toggled on and off with the E key, freeing up valuable screen space for an uncluttered interface.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038918/3c1c1bc9c2341556c4dceab4291c9c0d495da969.png[/img]

[b]Skill Tree System[/b]
[list]
[*] This update introduces the highly anticipated Skill Tree, adding depth and strategy to your gameplay:
[*] Divided into three branches: Training, Economy, and Health.
[*] Each branch has five progression stages, with the last two being Elite levels.
[*] Earn skill points by leveling up through training and spend them to unlock powerful upgrades.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038918/9efad49a0266bfa634d3f20758e11173e278dc2a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038918/4ac0b45d3b51bbc35c8f93076b8d477b9628f006.png[/img]

[b]When Will It Arrive?[/b]
The next update is almost ready and will roll out soon. The Gang Update will follow later, ensuring it’s fine-tuned and aligned with the Skill Tree System for a richer and more dynamic experience.

Thank you again for your patience and support. Your feedback means the world to me, and I can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the new update!

Stay tuned for more updates,
[b]Batu Tate[/b]

notes.title: Upcoming Update 0.17 – Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that update 0.17 is expected to go live around November 20-25. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming:

[b]Gang System Update [/b]– As promised, the gang system is arriving with this update! You’ll be able to:
[list]
[*] Join an existing gang and progress through its ranks.
[*] Unlock access to gang-exclusive items in the gang market based on your progression.
[*] Take on new gang missions to deepen your experience and help you climb the ranks.
[*] Experience a new crime level system, including the possibility of serving jail time.
[*] Engage in activities like ATM robbery and pickpocketing, each of which will help you develop unique skills.
[/list]

[b]New Boxing Training Mini-Game[/b] – The boxing training mini-game will be revamped, adding more fun and challenge to your training sessions.

[b]Additional Bug Fixes[/b] – We’ll also be cleaning up various bugs to ensure smoother gameplay.

Stay tuned, and thank you for your support as we continue to enhance the game!

notes.title: Update 0.16.0 is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to bring you update 0.16.0, with new features and fixes:

[b]Protein Powder Usage Bug Fixed:[/b] The issue with protein powder usage has been resolved.

[b]New Item: Gainer[/b] – The Gainer item has been added. When used, it prevents hunger, thirst, and energy loss during training sessions, helping you stay focused on your progress.

[b]Job Indicator on Map:[/b] A new indicator has been added to the map for jobs, making it easier to locate work opportunities.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: Update 0.15.8 is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just rolled out update 0.15.8, and here’s what’s new:

[b]Full-Time Job System:[/b] A new full-time job system has been introduced. When you take a job, you’ll be assigned a small hourly wage, and you can choose to work between 1 to 10 hours a day. At the end of each shift, you’ll get paid based on the hours worked.

[b]Boss Relationship:[/b] Your relationship with your boss progresses as you work. Once it reaches a certain level, you can ask for a raise and increase your hourly wage.

[b]Performance Improvements:[/b] We’ve made significant performance optimizations (something many of you have been asking for).

[b]Boxing Training Bug Fixed:[/b] The bug affecting boxing training has been resolved.

Thank you for your feedback and support! Enjoy the new features and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.15.25 is Now Live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We’ve just released update 0.15.25, and here’s what’s new:

[b]Protein Shot Added:[/b] A new item, the Protein Shot, is now available in the game. When used, it grants a training bonus to help boost your progress.

[b]Briefing Tutorial:[/b] We’ve added a new tutorial at the beginning of the game, providing a detailed guide to help players get started and understand the mechanics.

[b]Minor Bug Fixes:[/b] We’ve also addressed some minor issues to improve overall gameplay stability.
Thank you for your support and enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Upcoming Update: What's Coming in Version 0.16?
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to share what’s coming in the next update, version 0.16. Here's a sneak peek:

[b]Optimization Improvements:[/b] Further optimizations will be made to enhance performance across the board.

[b]Boxing Training Balancing:[/b] The penalties for boxing training will be reduced, bringing better balance to the game.

[b]Tutorial Brifing:[/b] A new tutorial will be added at the start of the game, making it easier for new players to get started.

[b]Gang System:[/b] Gangs are being introduced, allowing for illegal activities and a reputation system. With this reputation, you’ll be able to acquire items like power-up pills to aid in your progression.

[b]New Market Item:[/b] Protein supplements will be added to the market, offering a small training bonus.

We’re hard at work making sure these features are polished and ready to improve your experience. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update: Optimization Round 2 is Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to release the second part of our ongoing optimization updates (2 out of 4 total). In this update, we’ve made several improvements to enhance performance:

Reduced the overall GPU load for better graphics performance.
Shadows have been optimized for smoother gameplay and visual consistency.
Additional minor tweaks to improve stability and frame rates.
Thank you for your continued support! Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to fine-tune the game.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Road To Champion - Future Updates and New Features
notes.content:
Hello Champions!

We’re excited to share with you our plans for the upcoming updates of Road To Champion! Here's a sneak peek at what you can expect in future versions:

[b]0.16 Update: Optimization and Visual Enhancements[/b]
We’re focusing on improving overall performance and increasing visual quality.
Additionally, we’ll address reported bugs and release hotfixes as necessary to ensure a smoother experience.

[b]0.17 Update: New Full-Time Jobs[/b]
Two new full-time jobs will be added, offering more opportunities for players to progress during the early stages of the game.

[b]0.18 Update: Underground Fights[/b]
Before reaching the strength needed for official boxing matches, players will have the option to participate in underground fights for illegal early-stage earnings.

[b]0.19 Update: Market Expansion[/b]
The in-game market will expand with new food, drinks, and protein bars.
Protein bars will boost training gains for a limited time, adding strategic depth to your preparation.

[b]0.20 Update: Car Modifications[/b]
We’ll introduce new car modifications, including ECU tuning and tire grip adjustments, allowing players to optimize their vehicles for drifting or better road handling.

[b]0.21 Update: Marriage System[/b]
Players will be able to get married! If you own a house, your spouse will be waiting at home, and you can buy them gifts or engage in other interactions. If they become unhappy, divorce could follow.

[b]0.22 Update: Gangs and Illegal Activities[/b]
Gangs will be introduced, giving players the chance to engage in early-stage illegal activities such as theft and assault.

These are just a few of the exciting features we have planned for Road To Champion. We’ll keep listening to your feedback and improving the game as we move forward!

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Stay tuned for more updates!

Best regards,
The Road To Champion Team

notes.title: Road To Champion - Community Feedback and Bug Reports
notes.content:
Hello Champions!

We’re excited to have you join us on this journey with Road To Champion! Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for improvements, please share them in the comments below. We want to ensure that Road To Champion delivers the best experience possible, and your input will help us achieve that.

Thank you for your support, and we look forward to hearing from you!

Best regards,
The Road To Champion Team
